title: Categorified Cluster Structures on Coulomb Branches of Certain Star-Shaped Quivers
summary: We study the quantized $K$-theoretic Coulomb branches of framed star-shaped quivers with central gauge dimension $n\geq2$, $r-1$ one-dimensional outer gauge vertices, and a one-dimensional framing at the central vertex. For $n=2$ and arbitrary $r\geq1$, and for every $n\geq2$ with $1\leq r\leq5$, we prove that the loop-graded Koszul-perverse heart is a monoidal categorification of the associated quantum cluster algebra over $\mathbb{Z}[v^{\pm1}]$.
